decisions.reason: The devore line sits close to the core collection and the industry is growing, so performance likely meets aspirations, and slack in the stocked warehouse lets the firm carry it despite no evidence after 2019.

The transparent burnout line is a natural part of the decoration range, and without signs of a shortfall there is no trigger for problemistic search, though fashion-driven fabrics rotate out over time.
This single burnout fabric overlaps with the other burnout lines and could be pruned in a collection refresh, but low carrying costs and growing turnover favour keeping it for now.
Velour-like upholstery fabric has steady demand in interior textiles and builds on the established offer, so it likely meets aspiration levels.
Flame-retardant fabrics serve continuous contract and retail needs, and reorder continuity is part of the firm's value promise, making a drop unlikely.
Satin polyester lining is a staple complement to the sewing and made-to-measure service, gives steady reorders and low risk, and should be kept.
